scenes.sub: Turn them into a podcast, not a
scenes.say: Stop reading long PDFs. There's a free tool that turns them into a podcast.

scenes.name: NotebookLM
scenes.line: Upload any PDF, link or notes → get a *two-host podcast* about it
scenes.say: It's called NotebookLM, by Google. Upload a PDF, a link or your notes, and it creates a two-host podcast about them.

scenes.title: How to do it in *60 seconds*
scenes.say: Create a notebook. Add your sources. Then tap Audio Overview and press generate.

scenes.title: Pro *tricks*:
items: Customize: tell the hosts what to focus on
Join the chat and ask them questions live
Works for reports, books and courses
scenes.say: Pro tricks: customize what the hosts focus on, and join the conversation to ask them questions.
Learn on your commute, not your desk.
